body: Quality Council of India, I-CAS Halal, certification bodies accredited by NABCB
import_recognition: Required for meat and meat product exports to listed halal-certifying markets (15 countries from 16 Oct 2024; 35 after DGFT Notification 59/2025-26).
notes: Export scheme only. From a web search summary; primary page not opened.

body: SFDA Halal Center (took over registration of halal certification bodies from the Muslim World League in August 2020)
import_recognition: Meat and poultry shipments need a manufacturer halal certificate and a per-shipment halal slaughter certificate from a body recognised by the SFDA Halal Center (since November 2020).
notes: No halal certification route for cell-based meat found. Food approval has a novel food regulation (SFDA.FD 5013), which bears on L, not on this field; L_includes_halal is likely true for SAU. Web search only. From a web search summary; primary page not opened.

body: Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology (MoIAT); registered halal certification bodies
import_recognition: MoIAT-recognised halal certificate mandatory for raw and processed meat, slaughter by-products and products containing them.
notes: Abu Dhabi (ADAFSA, QCC, ADIO) announced a novel-food approval framework; that is L, not halal certification. Web search only. From a web search summary; primary page not opened.
